sources.title: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow

sources.title: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
sources.snippet: We instantiate the PT-Flow paradigm as ODEWorld, a highly versatile and efficient continuous-time predictive architecture for both high-fidelity video generation and effective robotic policy learning.
